# Juan Miguel

> Personal portfolio of Juan Miguel, software engineer and technology consultant in Madrid.

Juan Miguel designs and builds systems that can be explained, operated and verified. Work spans system architecture, applied security and delivery automation. Copy is in Spanish.

## Pages

- [Home](https://juan-miii.github.io/): single page portfolio. Discipline, work, experience, profile, contact.
- [llms.txt](https://juan-miii.github.io/llms.txt): this file.

## Projects

- [Portfolio platform](https://github.com/juan-miii/juan-miii.github.io): content-driven personal site with a verifiable delivery chain. Astro monorepo, pnpm, Turborepo.
- [TFG automation](https://github.com/juan-miii/tfg): automated academic exercise correction with GitHub Actions and GitHub Classroom. Java, JUnit, Maven.

## Experience

- [Accenture](https://www.accenture.com): digital identity consulting in public sector (2024-2025).
- [PricewaterhouseCoopers](https://www.pwc.es): business security solutions, governance, risk and compliance (current).
